subjectIdentity: The Git commit containing this receipt is the worker subject; no circular embedded commit or self-hash.

designFreeze.entrypoint: CanonicalTripService.list/detail in src/services/canonicalTripService.ts; internal only, no mounted caller.
designFreeze.ownership: Only ENCHO_DIRECT with immutable holder_principal=user:<positive INT account ID>. Anonymous/session, external and null identities excluded. No Host/Admin override or ownership transfer.
designFreeze.authentication: Constructor-injected TripAuthenticationPort resolves a trusted context and returns a signed read proof. PostgreSQL verifies it independently of request IDs, role flags or GUC. Only an explicitly trusted local fixture adapter exists; no production consumer authentication/revocation is claimed.
designFreeze.proofProtocol: HMAC-SHA256/RFC2104, fixed 32-byte key; UTF-8 q1-trip-read-v1 LF keyId LF user:accountId LF integer expiry epoch seconds LF canonical PostgreSQL UUID text nonce. Maximum 300-second lifetime. Private keyring is empty in migration; no production key/configuration is introduced.
designFreeze.readCapability: 063 adds encho_trip_projection NOLOGIN/NOINHERIT SELECT-only definer, private helpers/keyring, two allowlisted public-schema executable functions for separately provisioned encho_trip_reader LOGIN/NOINHERIT. No runtime receives raw tables, effective views or 057 helpers. Roles have no memberships, superuser/BYPASSRLS, protected ownership, schema/database CREATE, raw DML or other public SECURITY DEFINER execution authority.
designFreeze.readiness: Every call verifies actual attributes/ACLs, ownership, function settings, required relations/forced RLS and exact accepted 052-062 history fingerprints. A missing authority fails even for an empty account. No name-only or owner fallback.
designFreeze.snapshot: One held connection, READ ONLY REPEATABLE READ; stable routines, controlled pg_catalog/pg_temp search_path, schema-qualified relations, parameterized queries, no writer locks or principal GUC. COMMIT/ROLLBACK cleanup; socket errors observed while leased and broken clients discarded.
designFreeze.dto: Strict ENCHO_TRIP_V1; root inventory commitment, effective V1 or sealed successor snapshot, original paid composition, current original quote/hold payment evidence, accepted lifecycle view and exact release, qualified high-level refund evidence. No raw payload, approval packet, credential, tax total or mutable current listing price.
designFreeze.statusHonesty: Matched capture alone is not paid composition. Original paid bridge remains historical truth through later reconciliation. V2 financial clearance is NOT_ESTABLISHED. Refund authorization is RECORDED_ONLY; execution/settlement NOT_ESTABLISHED, balance UNSUPPORTED, external history UNKNOWN. Check-in/fulfillment/dispute authority UNSUPPORTED.
designFreeze.cursor: Separate server HMAC key, exact UTC microsecond timestamp plus UUID keyset, bound to account and expiry. No unsigned/cross-account/tampered cursor adoption.

q1Coverage: Own/foreign/nonexistent, Host/Admin no override, valid session/external/null exclusion; forged context/body/MAC/nonce/key/audience and expired/disabled proof denial; raw GUC/helper/key/issuer denial.

Inventory-only, matched capture without composition, no reservation from capture, valid paid bridge and immutable paid history through later conflict/reconciliation; authorization-only refund projection and data minimization.
V1, unsealed V2/V3 containment, sealed V2 room/allocation and unsupported financial clearance, invalid room/offer allocation/seal denial; controlled concurrent sealing after RR snapshot acquisition.

ACTIVE/request/CANCELLED distinctions, exact immutable V1 and version-aware V2 release, contradictory source fail-closed through actual restricted service; owner-only synthetic corruption restored and isolated.

PUBLIC/12 unintended runtimes, no raw reads/DML/CREATE/issuer/SET ROLE; broad membership, column privilege, BYPASSRLS, schema CREATE, noncanonical-named issuer EXECUTE and bad definer path drift rejected.

Missing source authority/forced RLS/history drift denied for empty account; one-connection two-account commits/rollbacks, actual lock timeout and backend termination; simulated COMMIT/ROLLBACK transport loss; no leaked principal/role/transaction state.

Bounded stable keyset with equal timestamp UUID ties, account/cursor tamper/expiry denial, strict DTO, immutable booked prices and no domain mutation; SQL/Node HMAC interoperability plus RFC4231 vector.
